meta.title: Session autospace
meta.description: Start a conversation without choosing a workspace. On the new-conversation screen, open the workspace menu and pick "No workspace": the plugin creates <working path>/session-<id> for that conversation, uses it as the session's working directory and sandbox boundary, and keeps it isolated from every other conversation. After the first message the temporary "No workspace" group leaves the sidebar and the conversation sits in Ungrouped. The choice is remembered: once you pick "No workspace", New Session starts another scratch conversation instead of returning to the last workspace, and picking a real workspace clears that. Settings -> Plugins -> Session autospace sets the working path (default ~/DSH), switches each part on or off, and manages the scratch conversations: search, filter, open, rename, pin, archive, reveal, and move to Trash. While a conversation is staged, the sidebar shows that temporary group beside any Ungrouped group it already has; the group disappears as soon as the conversation starts or is left. DSH has no permanent delete, so deleting archives the conversation and moves its folder to the system Trash.
